summary: Implemented prepared SPARQL Update (prepareUpdate). Changes: added Update(prologue, algebra) container in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py now returns an Update built from the translated prologue and algebra list; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; processor.py gains prepareUpdate (records _original_args like prepareQuery) and the update processor passes containers through; prepareUpdate exported from rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py; new test module test/test_sparql_prepared_update.py added. Deviation: an empty request returns Update(Prologue(), []) rather than a bare empty list, so evaluating it does not raise. Not verified: no tests were run (repository execution was prohibited), so the new tests and existing DAWG/prepareQuery tests are unconfirmed; the initial-bindings test with an empty WHERE clause and the Graph.update initBindings keyword are assumed. No commits made.
